name: Wait for phone auth + install
command: ADB="$HOME/.local/share/open-teams-android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; for i in $(seq 1 300); do s=$($ADB devices | awk '/R5CWA2LF04E/{print $2}'); [ "$s" = "device" ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo "state=$s"; [ "$s" = "device" ] || exit 1; A="$ADB -s R5CWA2LF04E"; $A shell getprop ro.product.model; $A shell getprop ro.build.version.release; $A shell dumpsys webviewupdate | grep -E "Current WebView package" | head -1; $A install -r /home/hxd/vincent/projects/open-teams/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && $A shell am start -n io.github.gangofbeads.openteams/.MainActivity
